## Checklist

- [ ] The change is one logical unit and the diff has no generated output
- [ ] The repository's own checks pass on the head commit
- [ ] No secret, credential, dataset, or large binary is added
- [ ] Documentation or changelog updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Security-sensitive change (sandbox, policy, credentials, release): second human review requested
